icp_definition.company_profile: Chief Compliance Officer at Top 100 US banks (assets > $50B), responsible for AI governance. $1B+ annual compliance budget. Evaluates solutions Q3-Q4 annually for next fiscal budget cycle.
icp_definition.budget_authority: CCO with approval from CRO and Technology Governance Committee
where_to_find: LinkedIn (search: CCO at banks with 'regulatory' mentions)

channel_priorities.why_this_channel: Highest trust for compliance, longest sales cycles, needs CEO/founder credibility
Consultants already embedded with CCOs; trusted advisors; high conversion rate
CCOs gather at ABA/AFCC conferences; speaking = credibility builder

key_objectives: Identify and reach 20 CCOs at Target 50 banks
Validate value proposition in customer conversations
launch_sequence.customer_targets: Top 50 banks CCOs, high pain, 4-6 month budgets
launch_sequence.success_criteria: 2 pilot customers signed, validated willingness-to-pay, identified champion pattern

launch_sequence.team_composition: CEO + VP of Sales + 1 Implementation Engineer
launch_sequence.success_criteria: 1st contract signed, customer in production, 90-day success metrics documented

key_objectives: Close 2nd and 3rd customer via direct sales
launch_sequence.team_composition: CEO + VP of Sales (full-time hire) + Sales Dev Rep
launch_sequence.customer_targets: Next 10 Target 50 banks; consulting firms (2-3 partnerships)
launch_sequence.success_criteria: 3 total customers by week 12, 2 partnerships in discussion, 2 conference speaking slots confirmed

key_objectives: Scale direct sales funnel (6+ customers in pipeline)
Measure CAC and conversion rates per channel
launch_sequence.team_composition: VP of Sales (leading team), 2 Account Executives, 1 Sales Dev Rep, 1 Customer Success
launch_sequence.customer_targets: Mix of direct and partner-sourced opportunities
launch_sequence.success_criteria: 6 total customers signed (Year 1 target 12), $250K MRR, repeat partnership revenue $50K/month

milestones: Week 1: List 20 target CCOs, initiate 5 outreach conversations
Week 2: 10 CCO discovery calls booked, define pilot scope
Week 4: 2 pilots in progress, customer feedback collected
activities: CEO sends personalized outreach to 20 CCOs (LinkedIn + email)
VP of Sales manages meeting cadence and follow-up
Product team supports pilot scope and success criteria

milestones: Week 5: 1 pilot completing successfully, ROI documented
Week 7: Partnership discussions with 3 consulting firms initiated
Week 8: 2nd and 3rd customers in pipeline (60%+ qualified)
activities: VP of Sales builds direct sales pipeline (8+ target prospects)
Partnership Manager initiates consulting firm conversations

milestones: Week 9: 1st customer live in production, case study drafted
Week 10: 2nd and 3rd customers signed, partnership agreements with 2 firms
Week 11: Speaking slot confirmed at ABA Q2 conference
Week 12: 6+ customers in funnel, $250K MRR baseline established
activities: Customer success team deploys success program (onboarding, training, QBRs)
Marketing creates case study and ROI calculator
VP of Sales hires 1st Account Executive
Finance tracks CAC by channel and conversion metrics

acquisition_funnel.awareness_to_first_call: Founder outreach + warm introductions + conference visibility
acquisition_funnel.first_call_to_demo: Discovery call (30 min) identifies pain fit; demo (45 min) shows product match
acquisition_funnel.demo_to_proposal: 2-week evaluation period, customer tests on test environment, propose pilot or production
acquisition_funnel.proposal_to_close: Legal review (2 weeks), exec approval (1 week), contract signature (1 week) = ~4 weeks

assumptions: Sales cycle remains 4 months even at scale (may compress with partner channels)
CAC of $120K sustainable via founder sales (improves with brand after 1st 3 customers)
Partnership channel will deliver 30% of Year 1 revenue (consulting firm embedded relationships)
LTV:CAC ratio of 12:1 supports payback period of 8 months (from Vol 4 unit economics)
data_gaps: Actual consulting firm interest in partnership model (need to validate)
Conference attendance by target CCOs (ABA history unknown)
Competitive GTM approach (how are RegulatoryAI and ModelWatch selling?)
Win/loss analysis from pilots (need to document)
confidence_rationale: ICP definition is clear and narrow (Top 100 banks CCOs). Channel priorities grounded in Vol 2 buying process and Vol 4 CAC. 90-day playbook is realistic with founder-led sales focus. However, confidence is not higher because partnership channel viability needs validation, consulting firm interest is assumed, and sales productivity (closing 12 customers Year 1) requires strong execution. Conference speaking effectiveness unknown.
